messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high paging + warmup failures detected on cluster asia-east-1-gpu-pool-3. Symptoms: OOM during model load, CUDA driver errors, and repeated deserialization timeouts. 5xx rate ~3% overall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/warmup-oom

maria_oncall: Ack. I'm on it — standing up a mitigation thread. @zach_sre can you check node-level OOM logs and current eviction queue?

zach_sre: Looking. dmesg shows recent GPU reset on node gpu-023; kernel oom-killer inactive but container oom events around 11:42:13. Eviction queue contains model: rwd-large-v2 (hot) x3.

kelly_runtime: Also seeing compile timeout spikes during warmup for rwd-large-v2: 
```
compile timeout: ctx=warmup seq=4096 model=rwd-large-v2 err=timeout(120s)
```
Possible kernel/jit hang + deserialization latency.

priya_ml: We saw a flaky artifact upload earlier — manifest checksum mismatch on a subset of shards. Could cause deserializing worker to spin then time out. I can re-publish artifact to S3 and bump manifest; needs coord with platform.

jamie_support: FYI, a handful of customers in APAC reported degraded latency and occasional 5xx errors in the last 15m. CS is triaging. No escalations yet but one enterprise customer hit rate limit alerts.

maria_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) disable warmup for the hot variant on that pool, 2) route traffic to rwd-small-fallback for new requests, 3) reduce per-node warmup concurrency to 1, 4) restart warmup job controller on affected nodes. I'm going to run the commands.

maria_oncall: Running: `kubectl -n rwd-warmup set env deploy/warmup-controller REDWOOD_WARMUP_ENABLED=false --record`

maria_oncall: Output: `deployment.apps/warmup-controller env updated`

maria_oncall: Reduce concurrency: `kubectl -n rwd-warmup patch deploy/warmup-controller -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"warmup","env":[{"name":"WARMUP_CONCURRENCY","value":"1"}]}]}}}}'`

maria_oncall: Output: `deployment.apps/warmup-controller patched`

tom_platform: I'll trigger artifact re-pull for rwd-large-v2 on gpu-023 and mark node for cordon+drain if it keeps failing. Command: `sudo systemctl restart rwd-artifact-fetcher` on node, and `kubectl cordon gpu-023` if next failure.

zach_sre: Heap/allocs look spiky. I'm also bumping the kernel MIG timeout settings and inspecting GPU driver logs. Could be intermittent driver hang during deserialize.

kelly_runtime: As a quick runtime fallback we can enable the fast-quantized variant for that model group: `api: routing -> model_alias=rwd-large-q8a fallback=rwd-large-q4a` That will shave memory and compile time. I'll push a temp policy.

priya_ml: I pushed a re-built artifact with fixed shard order and new checksum. S3 object: s3://redwood-models/rwd-large-v2/artifact-4532109999-fixed.tar.gz. Recommend invalidating existing cached artifacts on the pool.

maria_oncall: Invalidating cache on pool: `rwdctl pool invalidate-cache asia-east-1-gpu-pool-3 --model rwd-large-v2`

maria_oncall: Output: `invalidation queued (4 nodes)`

jamie_support: Noting that latency is improving for some customers after routing fallback. Still seeing intermittent 5xx for warmup traffic only. I'll update CS threads.

lucy_csm: Please add a short note for customer comms: cause = model artifact deserialization + driver reset causing warmup OOMs; mitigation = routing to fallback + artifact re-publish.

kelly_runtime: Patch applied to routing. Monitoring compile-timeouts and warmup success rate.

zach_sre: After cordoning gpu-023 and restarting artifact-fetcher, warmup logs show fewer deserializing hangs. No new CUDA resets in last 3m.

maria_oncall: Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when the issue is green on their end. I'll keep channel open for 30m and then transition to postmortem investigations.

incident-bot: INCIDENT update: status=mitigated. impact=reduced from 3% 5xx to 0.2% 5xx for user-facing traffic. warmup_failure_rate on pool=down from 14% -> 1.6%. Handed off to SRE/ML for root cause and PM for customer comms.

priya_ml: We'll run artifact validation tests and add an extra checksum/manifest verification step in the upload pipeline. Filing task: ML-3721.

kelly_runtime: Follow-up: add graceful abort for compile-jit if deserialization stalls >45s, to avoid OOM buildup. Filed ENG-RUNTIME-881.

zach_sre: I'll collect kernel + driver dumps and attach to the postmortem.

maria_oncall: Closing mitigation. Last check: no new warmup OOMs in 10m. If nothing pops in next 20m I'll mark incident resolved and start RCA thread.

jamie_support: CS updated customers with interim message. No critical escalations.

lucy_csm: Thanks all.
